statements.status_notes: CVE-2018-18064 is an out-of-bounds stack write demonstrated through WebKitGTK+ driving cairo's rectangular scan converter with crafted web documents; the Debian security tracker marks it unimportant. WebKitGTK is not present in this image (no libwebkit object exists on disk, verified in both variants). Cairo here is used by GTK and pango for chromium's local UI drawing, while web and test content rasterizes through chromium's bundled Skia, so crafted documents never reach the vulnerable converter path.
